admission.justification: Avoids stealing modified browser chords or silently losing existing task navigation when adding parent arrows.

applicability: Keyboard disclosure on a focused Operations parent row, not a new keyboard path for completed folds.
conditions: Only unmodified left/right arrows act on a focused parent row, and an arrow requests a toggle only when its desired state differs.
A deliberate parent arrow may end the current chosen-document hold and change disclosure without changing the selected document; the release expires when the selection episode changes (INV-ME6CA1).
Non-parent rows and completed-fold lines gain no arrow handler. Modified chords and all other keys retain their existing browser/list behavior.
exclusions: Changing up/down, Enter or typeahead reach.

evidence: dashboard/src/panels/lifecycle-list/hierarchy.test.tsx: "opens and closes a parent row with the right and left arrow keys"; sandbox tries in notes/run3/operations-sidebar-proposal/comparison/behave.json (arrowKeys, both widths) and captures/foldkey.json; comparison page, section "The one addition".

statement: On a focused Operations parent row, plain right opens it and plain left closes it, including a selected ancestor held open for the chosen document when the arrow changes state. Task rows and completed-fold lines gain no left/right action. Alt, Ctrl, Shift and Meta chords stay with the browser; up, down, Enter and visible-text typeahead keep their existing reach.
